title: 白雪公主和七个小矮人
en: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
creator: Walt Disney
note: 世界第一部彩色动画长片，让动画从短片一跃成为影院的正式艺术。
noteEn: The first full-length animated feature, lifting cartoons into the cinema's mainstream.

title: 木偶奇遇记
creator: Walt Disney
note: 说谎就长鼻子的匹诺曹，把「诚实」二字唱进一代人的童年底色。
noteEn: A boy whose nose grows when he lies — honesty sung into a generation's childhood.

title: 幻想曲
creator: Walt Disney
note: 米老鼠敲响《魔法师的学徒》，把古典音乐画成无叙事的纯视觉诗。
noteEn: Mickey as the sorcerer's apprentice — classical music rendered as pure visual poetry.

title: 美女与野兽
creator: Gary Trousdale, Kirk Wise
note: 首部提名奥斯卡最佳影片的动画，把百老汇音乐剧的骨架搬进赛璐珞。
noteEn: The first animated film nominated for Best Picture, transplanting Broadway's bones into cel animation.

title: 狮子王
creator: Roger Allers, Rob Minkoff
note: 把《哈姆雷特》放到非洲草原，生死轮回让动画第一次认真地谈代价。
noteEn: Hamlet on the savanna — the circle of life made animation talk seriously about cost.

title: 玩具总动员
creator: John Lasseter
note: 全球首部全 CG 长片，玩具的嫉妒与忠诚定义了皮克斯的情感语法。
noteEn: The first all-CG feature; the toys' jealousy and loyalty defined Pixar's emotional grammar.

title: 海底总动员
creator: Andrew Stanton
note: 用横跨大洋的寻子冒险讲一个父亲的放手，每一帧海水都在呼吸。
noteEn: An ocean-wide quest about a father letting go — every frame of water seems to breathe.

title: 超人总动员
creator: Brad Bird
note: 中年危机的超级英雄一家，动作场面是动画界的谍战巅峰。
noteEn: Superheroes with a midlife crisis — action staging that rivals live-action spy films.

title: 机器人总动员
creator: Andrew Stanton
note: 前四十分钟几乎无对白，垃圾星球上的清洁机器人对着绿色植物心动。
noteEn: Nearly silent for forty minutes — a trash-compacting robot falls for a green sprout.

title: 飞屋环游记
creator: Pete Docter
note: 开头四分钟讲完一生，然后用万千气球把房子拽向天堂瀑布。
noteEn: Four minutes to tell a lifetime, then a thousand balloons drag a house to Paradise Falls.

title: 玩具总动员3
creator: Lee Unkrich
note: 玩具被送进焚化炉的那一幕，是皮克斯对「长大与告别」最重的一笔。
noteEn: The toys at the incinerator — Pixar's heaviest statement on growing up and letting go.

title: 头脑特工队
creator: Pete Docter
note: 把情绪做成五个小人，告诉你悲伤其实是成长真正的燃料。
noteEn: Emotions as five little people — sadness turns out to be the real fuel of growing up.

title: 蜘蛛侠：平行宇宙
creator: Bob Persichetti, Peter Ramsey, Rodney Rothman
note: 漫画半色调、破格分镜、六位蜘蛛侠同框，把纸页质感炸进了银幕。
noteEn: Halftone dots, broken panels, six Spider-People — comic-page texture detonated on screen.

title: 钢铁巨人
creator: Brad Bird
note: 冷战底色里「你选择成为什么样的人」的温柔反问，票房的败笔、影史的遗珠。
noteEn: A gentle 'you are who you choose to be' against the Cold War — a flop at release, a canon gem.

title: 失常
creator: Charlie Kaufman, Duke Johnson
note: 定格动画拍中年男人在千人一面的世界里，撞见唯一不同的声音。
noteEn: Stop-motion for a midlife man who, in a world of identical faces, meets one unique voice.

title: 龙猫
creator: 宫崎骏
note: 把乡愁画成毛茸茸的森林守护神，龙猫巴士载着全世界失眠的孩子回家。
noteEn: Nostalgia as a furry forest spirit; the Catbus carries every sleepless child home.

title: 萤火虫之墓
creator: 高畑勋
note: 兄妹在战败后的日本挨饿，反战不是口号，而是每一勺糖水的重量。
noteEn: A brother and sister starve in postwar Japan — anti-war made of each spoonful of sugar water.

title: 幽灵公主
creator: 宫崎骏
note: 森林与铁镇没有对错只有互害，宫崎骏亲手撕掉非黑即白的童话。
noteEn: Forest and forge-town with no side entirely right — Miyazaki tearing up black-and-white fairy tales.

title: 阿基拉
creator: 大友克洋
note: 手绘赛博朋克的巅峰，霓虹都市与生物装甲点燃了九十年代全球动画热。
noteEn: The peak of hand-drawn cyberpunk, igniting the global anime boom of the nineties.

title: 攻壳机动队
creator: 押井守
note: 义体人素子的身份之问，是《黑客帝国》哲学与视觉的直接前身。
noteEn: Major Kusanagi's question of identity — the philosophical blueprint for The Matrix.

title: 未麻的部屋
creator: 今敏
note: 偶像转型演员的幻象崩塌，虚实剪辑比《黑天鹅》早了十三年。
noteEn: An idol's identity collapses in real time — reality-splicing that predates Black Swan by a decade.

title: 红辣椒
creator: 今敏
note: 梦境治疗仪让整座东京做同一个梦，是《盗梦空间》的视觉先声。
noteEn: A dream machine makes Tokyo share one dream — Inception's visual ancestor.

title: 你的名字。
creator: 新海诚
note: 彗星、绳结与互换身体，把「错过」拍成这个时代最动人的异地恋。
noteEn: Comets, braided cords and body-swapping — the era's most moving long-distance love story.

title: 辉夜姬物语
en: The Tale of the Princess Kaguya
creator: 高畑勋
note: 水墨淡彩的速写长卷，用最老的传说问一个最现代的问题：回月亮还是留在人间。
noteEn: A watercolor sketchbook epic asking an ancient question anew: the moon or this world?

title: 疯狂约会美丽都
creator: Sylvain Chomet
note: 法国式怪诞：老太太、胖狗与三轮车闯进大都会，几乎整片没有对白。
noteEn: French whimsy — a grandmother, a fat dog and a bicycle plunge into a metropolis, almost wordlessly.

title: 我在伊朗长大
creator: Marjane Satrapi, Vincent Paronnaud
note: 黑白漫画自传，在伊斯兰革命与流亡中长成一个女孩倔强的自我。
noteEn: A black-and-white comic autobiography — a girl's self forged through revolution and exile.

title: 海洋之歌
creator: Tomm Moore
note: 凯尔特神话里的海豹精与即将消亡的传说，几何装饰风的美术教科书。
noteEn: A selkie and a dying mythology — a textbook of geometric, decorative animation.

title: 狼行者
creator: Tomm Moore, Ross Stewart
note: 十七世纪爱尔兰的森林魔法，手绘线条里藏着对殖民与压制的隐喻。
noteEn: Woodland magic in seventeenth-century Ireland, with colonialism hidden in the hand-drawn lines.

title: 红海龟
creator: Michael Dudok de Wit
note: 吉卜力监制的无对白寓言，一个人与一只红龟在荒岛上的半生轮回。
noteEn: A dialogue-free fable produced by Studio Ghibli — one man, one turtle, a lifetime on an island.

title: 西葫芦的生活
creator: Claude Barras
note: 定格黏土孤儿院，把儿童眼中的创伤拍得既明亮又疼痛。
noteEn: Claymation in a children's home — trauma seen through a child's bright, hurting eyes.

title: 和巴什尔跳华尔兹
creator: Ari Folman
note: 动画重建记忆，一名以军士兵直面贝鲁特大屠杀的失忆与罪责。
noteEn: Animation as recovered memory — a soldier confronts amnesia and guilt over the Beirut massacre.

title: 大闹天宫
creator: 万籁鸣
note: 上美厂手绘神作，孙悟空的形象自此定格在几代华人的共同记忆里。
noteEn: Shanghai Animation Studio's hand-drawn classic that fixed Sun Wukong in a nation's memory.

title: 哪吒闹海
creator: 王树忱
note: 哪吒剔骨还父的悲壮，被上美厂画成东方的「叛逆即牺牲」。
noteEn: Nezha's self-sacrifice drawn as the East's fable of rebellion through sacrifice.

title: 山水情
creator: 特伟
note: 水墨动画的绝唱，古琴声里一师一徒，每一帧都是活的山水画。
noteEn: The swan song of ink-wash animation — a teacher and pupil bound by the qin's music.

title: 哪吒之魔童降世
creator: 饺子
note: 魔童设定重写「我命由我不由天」，一举打破中国动画的票房天花板。
noteEn: 'My fate is mine to decide' — a reimagined Nezha that broke China's animation box-office records.

title: 罗小黑战记
creator: MTJJ
note: 治愈系小黑猫流落人间，把国漫的利落打斗与温柔日常揉进同一帧。
noteEn: A healing black cat adrift among humans, blending crisp Chinese-style action with quiet warmth.

title: 北方的纳努克
creator: Robert J. Flaherty
note: 公认的纪录片起点，用镜头「重建」因纽特人冰原上的生存方式。
noteEn: The acknowledged birthplace of the documentary, reconstructing Inuit life on film.

title: 持摄影机的人
creator: Dziga Vertov
note: 一座城市的一日被剪成纯蒙太奇，摄影机既是主角也是眼睛。
noteEn: A day in the city edited as pure montage — the camera itself as hero and eye.

title: 夜与雾
creator: Alain Resnais
note: 彩色的集中营遗址与黑白档案交错，把大屠杀的寒意推进每一帧。
noteEn: Color ruins against black-and-white archives — the Holocaust's chill in every frame.

title: 日月无光
creator: Chris Marker
note: 一封没有收件人的影像信，在东京与非洲之间讨论时间、记忆与图像的熵。
noteEn: A video letter to no one, meditating on time, memory and the entropy of images.

title: 浩劫
creator: Claude Lanzmann
note: 九小时零影像资料的采访长卷，只让幸存者与凶手开口，档案都被悬置。
noteEn: Nine hours without archival footage — only survivors and perpetrators speak.

title: 美国哈兰县
creator: Barbara Kopple
note: 矿工罢工的枪火与歌声，让芭芭拉成为首位捧起奥斯卡纪录长片的女导演。
noteEn: Guns and singing in a miners' strike — Kopple became the first woman to win Best Documentary.

title: 篮球梦
creator: Steve James
note: 七年跟拍两名芝加哥少年的篮球梦，体育纪录片的巅峰与奥斯卡遗珠。
noteEn: Seven years tracking two Chicago teens' basketball dreams — the peak, and an Oscar snub, of sports docs.

title: 科伦拜校园事件
creator: Michael Moore
note: 从校园枪击一路追问美国的枪支文化，把纪录片变成一次社会手术。
noteEn: From a school shooting to America's gun culture — documentary as social surgery.

title: 华氏911
creator: Michael Moore
note: 首部拿下戛纳金棕榈的纪录片，直刺伊拉克战争与媒体合谋。
noteEn: The first documentary to win the Palme d'Or, aimed at the Iraq war and media complicity.

title: 战争迷雾
creator: Errol Morris
note: 麦克纳马拉的十一条经验，让决策者的愧疚像迷雾一样弥漫开来。
noteEn: McNamara's eleven lessons — a decision-maker's remorse spreading like fog.

title: 灰熊人
creator: Werner Herzog
note: 与灰熊共处十三年的提摩西，赫尔佐格在自恋里读出人性的深渊。
noteEn: Thirteen years among grizzlies — Herzog finds the human abyss inside self-delusion.

title: 海豚湾
creator: Louie Psihoyos
note: 卧底镜头潜入日本太地町，血色海湾让人无法移开眼睛。
noteEn: Hidden cameras in Taiji's cove — a blood-red bay you cannot look away from.

title: 难以忽视的真相
creator: Davis Guggenheim
note: 戈尔用一屏图表把全球变暖讲成最急迫、也最反高潮的幻灯片。
noteEn: Al Gore turns climate change into the most urgent — and least dramatic — slideshow ever.

title: 走钢丝的人
creator: James Marsh
note: 菲利普·珀蒂偷渡双子塔之间的钢丝，一次关于纯粹之美的完美盗窃。
noteEn: Petit's illegal wire-walk between the Twin Towers — a theft of pure beauty, perfectly told.

title: 寻找小糖人
creator: Malik Bendjelloul
note: 底特律歌手在南非成神而他一无所知，查案式纪录片最浪漫的一页。
noteEn: A Detroit singer worshipped in South Africa, unaware — investigative documentary at its most romantic.

title: 第四公民
creator: Laura Poitras
note: 与斯诺登在香港酒店实拍，让观众亲历一场泄密发生的现场。
noteEn: Filmed live with Snowden in a Hong Kong hotel — you witness the leak as it happens.

title: 艾米
creator: Asif Kapadia
note: 用家庭录像拼出艾米·怀恩豪斯的一生，成名与毁灭同步发生。
noteEn: Family tapes reassembling Amy Winehouse's life — fame and ruin arriving together.

title: 第十三修正案
creator: Ava DuVernay
note: 从宪法第十三修正案的漏洞，追踪美国监狱工业的百年闭环。
noteEn: From the 13th Amendment's loophole to America's prison-industrial century.

title: 杀戮演绎
creator: Joshua Oppenheimer
note: 让印尼大屠杀的刽子手重演当年的杀戮，纪录片伦理的极限实验。
noteEn: Having Indonesian executioners re-enact their murders — the outer limit of documentary ethics.

title: 海上火焰
creator: Gianfranco Rosi
note: 兰佩杜萨岛的孩童日常与难民船并置，罕见的纪录长片金熊奖得主。
noteEn: A child's routine on Lampedusa against refugee boats — a rare documentary Golden Bear.

title: 地球脉动
creator: Alastair Fothergill
note: 高空航拍与微距并列，BBC 把自然纪录片推上电影级的影像高度。
noteEn: Aerial and macro side by side — BBC pushed nature documentary to cinematic heights.

title: 帝企鹅日记
creator: Luc Jacquet
note: 帝企鹅在极寒里接力孵蛋，把动物行为拍成一部生存主义的史诗。
noteEn: Emperor penguins hatching eggs in polar cold — animal behavior as survivalist epic.

title: 迁徙的鸟
creator: Jacques Perrin
note: 与鸟群并肩飞行的航拍，三年跟拍只为一帧擦过翅膀的呼吸。
noteEn: Flying wing-to-wing with migratory birds — three years of shooting for one brush of a wing.

title: 我的章鱼老师
creator: Pippa Ehrlich, James Reed
note: 潜水员与一只章鱼的跨物种友谊，把海底拍成最温柔的相遇。
noteEn: A diver and an octopus's cross-species friendship — the gentlest encounter under the sea.

title: 徒手攀岩
creator: Elizabeth Chai Vasarhelyi, Jimmy Chin
note: 无保护攀登酋长岩，镜头的每一次靠近都让人手心出汗。
noteEn: Climbing El Capitan without ropes — every camera move makes you sweat with him.

title: 脸庞，村庄
creator: Agnès Varda, JR
note: 八十九岁的瓦尔达与三十三岁的 JR 开着卡车巡游法国，把巨幅肖像贴满村庄。
noteEn: An eighty-nine-year-old Varda and thirty-three-year-old JR plaster giant portraits across French villages.

title: 铁西区
creator: 王兵
note: 九小时纪录沈阳铁西区的工厂与失业，中国独立纪录片的纪念碑。
noteEn: Nine hours on Shenyang's Tiexi district and its lost factory jobs — a monument of Chinese indie documentary.

title: 灵魂乐之夏
creator: Questlove
note: 尘封五十年的哈莱姆文化节影像重见天日，一场被遗忘的黑人音乐盛典。
noteEn: Harlem's lost festival footage resurfaces after fifty years — a forgotten Black music celebration.
